_note: Latency profile from the canonical Haiku 4.5 concert_singer run (results/concert_singer/pilot_results_concert_singer_{OPERATOR}.csv). 'scored_n76' covers the 76 scored queries (paper statistics); 'executed_n80' adds the 4 expected-failure controls. latency_mcp_s is middleware-only (AST relink + validate + at most one LLM re-prompt; the baseline generation is reused, not re-timed). latency_baseline_s is the stale-schema LLM generation call. fraction_under_50ms = share of queries whose middleware path finished in under 0.05 s (deterministic path, no re-prompt). The latency tail is the re-prompt path taken when query/validate flags the relinked SQL; per-final-verdict means in middleware_latency_by_final_verdict.
